rationale: The claim involves a rear-end motor vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and injuries to the policyholder, which falls squarely under auto coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at ~8:15 AM by a driver traveling ~35 mph who failed to brake, resulting in a total loss of the vehicle (trunk fully crushed into back seat). Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; the at-fault driver's insurance information is available on the police report. Claim is classified HIGH severity due to total vehicle loss and multi-site injuries with potential for escalation.

case_facts.description: Policyholder was rear-ended at a red light by another driver traveling ~35 mph who did not brake. Entire trunk is crushed into the back seat.
case_facts.vehicle_status: Total loss — trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injuries: Policyholder has whiplash and a sprained wrist
case_facts.third_party_info: Other driver's insurance info on police report

rationale: A tree falling onto the policyholder's own parked vehicle is a comprehensive auto loss — damage is to the car, not the home structure, and the policy includes auto coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim (POL-1005) reports a wind-driven maple tree from their front yard fell onto their car parked in the driveway last night, smashing the hood and windshield. This is an auto comprehensive claim; the house was not damaged and no injuries were reported. Severity assessed as high — possible total loss pending physical inspection. Policy deductible is $1,000.

case_facts.incident_cause: Maple tree from policyholder's front yard fell due to wind and landed on parked car in driveway
case_facts.damage_description: Hood and windshield of car smashed by fallen tree; house not damaged
